verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions dbt, a dbt adapter, or vendor docs for dbt projects. The general claim that every ClickHouse client and driver works unchanged is only adjacent compatibility, not documented dbt support. CHKit is ObsessionDB's own schema-as-code tool, not dbt.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, dbt is a first-class citizen — a documented adapter or native dbt project support with vendor docs to match
